nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the range of reported removal rates of DEET during wastewater treatment procedures?
nodes.answer: The reported removal rates of DEET during wastewater treatment procedures range from 10 to 90%.

nodes.question: What experiment was designed to evaluate the removal capacity of various REEs/C?
nodes.answer: An experiment was designed for removing Pb(II) utilizing three tested REEs/Cs.
